author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: We discussed the registry requirements during the pipeline sync. {requirements_reuben.first} is firm that every model deployment requires a manual, documented review of evaluation metrics before it can be registered. This is non negotiable for compliance. To accommodate that manual step without slowing the team down, {data_dave} suggested we keep hyperparameter tuning done by hand. He is willing to accept the extra time cost of manual tuning in exchange for tighter control over data integrity. This trade off lets us maintain the strict governance {requirements_reuben.first} demands while ensuring the underlying data remains clean and reliable for the next forecast cycle.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that the author accepts the extra time cost of manual tuning in exchange for tighter control over data integrity.
